title: Marklar Coin
tagline: Create a Smart Contract with Solidity and deploy a small DApp.
description:
Create a ERC721 Token along with a DApp.

Our project was a nice introduction to the world of blockchain development. We wanted to start off simple and understand what we were writing. 

After countless hours of tutorials, reading docs and googling, we were able to deploy a small dApp to the Rinkeby testnet.
how_its_made:
This is our first time working with solidity. Project code consists of solidity, javascript, web3, node.js, express, html and brain juices. 



We were impressed on what we were able to accomplish in such short time and look forward to learning more about blockchain development!  



Thanks for the opportunity to let us be apart of the Hackathon.
